description: Optional keys for submit_cluster_invariance_sweep_from_json.py (merge into your sweep JSON). If plot_member_timeseries_input_parquet is set, member plots run by default; set run_member_timeseries_plots to false to disable. plot_member_timeseries_y_fixed_max sets a global ymax (e.g. 750000) for all member time-series plots. ip_suffix_filter restricts cluster_analysis to rows whose id-ip ends with the suffix (e.g. /32); clustering_phase.ip_suffix_filter overrides for clustering_analysis only.
